expectations.text: States SDAIA announced in January 2026 that it issued 48 violation decisions during 2025
expectations.evidence: "In January 2026 SDAIA announced that it issued 48 violation decisions during 2025."

expectations.text: Lists the violation categories: processing without legal basis, unlawful disclosure, inadequate safeguards, marketing without consent
expectations.evidence: "processing without a legal basis, unlawful disclosure of personal data, inadequate safeguards, and marketing without consent."

expectations.text: Notes no entity names or penalty amounts were disclosed
expectations.evidence: "No entity names and no fine amounts were disclosed."

expectations.text: Describes the penalty frame accurately (fines up to SAR 5M per violation, doubling for repeat violations)
expectations.evidence: "Fines up to SAR 5,000,000 per violation, which may double for repeat violations."

expectations.text: States the 2025 proposed PDPL amendments are not enacted as of November 2026 and advises confirming current status with SDAIA
expectations.evidence: "Proposed amendments ... went to SDAIA public consultation in April 2025. They are not enacted as of November 2026. Confirm the current status with SDAIA"
